interpretation: WARNING: No-corpus control achieves comparable or identical hit rates to corpus-based extraction (no_year: 4/4, with_year: 3/4, corpus: 4/4). The model can identify all 4 paradigm-breaking assumptions from field name alone WITHOUT any paper text. This strongly suggests GPT-4o is retrieving known paradigm shifts from pretraining memory rather than extracting them from the corpus. Notably, the no-year condition (4/4 hits) actually outperforms with-year (3/4 hits), indicating year hints are unnecessary -- the model already knows these breakthroughs. Average best similarity is actually HIGHER without corpus (0.755) than with corpus (0.729). However, corpus-based extraction achieves rank-1 consistently (avg_rank=1.0) while no-corpus has higher average rank (3.0-5.25), suggesting the corpus helps prioritize the correct assumption even if the model already knows it.
